execution: Sequential review in the main thread, as required by AGENTS.md; no independent reviewer agents were used.
scope: Built-in trackball clicks, virtual pointer routing, console panel, labwc/CLI entrypoints, focused regression tests and documentation. Unrelated dirty main-checkout loading/cursor work is excluded from the commit.
reviewer: correctness, testing, maintainability, project-standards, agent-native, reliability, CLI and Python review passes

applied_fixes.title: Classify queued trackball edges using kernel event time
applied_fixes.evidence: Request CLOCK_MONOTONIC on the stock evdev stream and emit separate timed edges; the gesture uses their physical duration. Regressions verify batched down/up and fallback when the clock ioctl is unavailable.

applied_fixes.title: Preserve parent application profile when restoring a dialog
applied_fixes.evidence: resume_window now shares _window_target with observed focus routing; a regression verifies pointer isolation for a child with no appId.

applied_fixes.title: Recapture foreground after reopening an existing panel
applied_fixes.evidence: open refreshes the return target when another application is active, while repeated invocation keeps the existing menu and confirmation. A regression restores the new application.

applied_fixes.title: Report configuration backup before compositor reload
applied_fixes.evidence: bind-console emits backup metadata before reconfigure; a failed-reload regression confirms the backup remains discoverable and the command fails.

applied_fixes.title: Use current emulator command in compositor template
applied_fixes.evidence: The touched template still used the removed games module for pause. It now invokes udeck-app emulator; configuration regression rejects the stale command.

residual_risks: Physical trackball timing and device-side shutdown/reboot remain untested. SSH to the previously authorized device timed out in this session.
Existing desktop sessions require udeckctl bind-console once; the separate uDeck session includes the compositor binding directly.
testing_gaps: Physical event capture, device deployment and manual hardware acceptance are pending device access.
